summary: Practise privacy records, risk screening, request tracking and incident workflows. Explore this five-day data protection training course.
lede: Data protection training helps privacy, records, technology and operational professionals document personal-data handling and support routine privacy decisions. Practical exercises cover mapping processing activities, reviewing access and retention evidence, screening privacy risks, tracking data access requests and preparing incident records, with ISO/IEC 29100 and the NIST Privacy Framework used as reference points.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who handle personal data or support privacy decisions in operational workflows. It is designed for people who need practical records, checks and escalation steps rather than advanced legal or technical implementation.
modules: OECD Privacy Guidance and Management Reporting
prerequisites: No coding or specialist privacy qualification is required. Working familiarity with routine personal-data handling is useful.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
